review:
A bright, pastel cluster-style game where Sun Ray Frames reshape the grid. A frame lands on a low, high or wild symbol at the start of a spin, then spreads up and down, sideways, or in all four directions, turning everything in its path into that symbol.

A four-way frame on a wild is the dream – it can paint a cross of wilds right through the grid. Free spins push the odds towards more and stronger frames. 10,000x max, and a nice change from Hacksaw's grittier games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
